finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers can get a full refund (minus processor fees) if they cancel a new paid subscription within 60 days.

quote.text: If you aren’t satisfied with your Stepsy subscription, you can cancel within the first 60 days of a new subscription and upon request, receive a full refund, except for the commission of the payment processor.

finePrint.summary: After 14 days, refund requests are decided case-by-case at the vendor's sole discretion.

quote.text: A refund request for a subscription canceled after more than 14 days will be dealt with on a case by case basis at our sole discretion.

finePrint.summary: Buyers whose accounts are terminated for repeated violations get no refund.

quote.text: Please note that we do not offer refunds to Members whose accounts are terminated as a result of repeated infringement of these Terms of Use.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change the terms at any time by posting them, and continued use means acceptance.

trials.reasoning: The binding terms let Stepsy discontinue the service at any time without notice and revoke permission to use it at any time for any reason, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Stepsy reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Service (or any part thereof) with or without notice.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor can discontinue the service at any time without notice.

exhibits.quote: Use of the Service is with the permission of Stepsy, which may be revoked at any time, for any reason, in Stepsy’s sole discretion.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is revocable at the vendor’s sole discretion for any reason.

exhibits.quote: which is (1) one-time payment for Pro lifetime use, (2) has no limits
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Stepsy was sold as a one-time payment for lifetime use.

exhibits.quote: has no limits to the processes you can record, and (3) has the option to automatically export to either Google Docs or HTML!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms there are no limits on the number of processes that can be recorded.

exhibits.quote: A refund request for a subscription canceled after more than 14 days will be dealt with on a case by case basis at our sole discretion.
exhibits.argument: The 60-day guarantee is limited because refunds after 14 days are discretionary and case by case.

exhibits.argument: The money-back promise is not full because payment processor commission is excluded.

exhibits.quote: If you aren’t satisfied with your Stepsy subscription, you can cancel within the first 60 days of a new subscription and upon request, receive a full refund, except for the commission of the payment processor.
exhibits.argument: Vendor refund policy states a full refund is available when cancelling within the first 60 days.

exhibits.quote: I did not like this product, and I got a refund after a test run.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they received a refund after trying the product.
